tiers.command: dart run dev/tools/embed_assets.dart && dart analyze --fatal-infos && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_kernel && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_core && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_workflow && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_runtime && dart test --reporter=failures-only -x slow apps/dartclaw_cli

proofs.command: dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_core/test/knowledge/temporal_knowledge_graph_service_test.dart --name "allFacts applies search and limit in the database read"

dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_kernel/test/database_config_test.dart packages/dartclaw_runtime/test/config/config_serializer_test.dart && dart run packages/dartclaw_kernel/tool/generate_config_schema.dart --check && bash dev/tools/fitness/check_config_reference_drift.sh && dart test --reporter=failures-only dev/fitness/test/config_section_tier_coverage_test.dart dev/fitness/test/config_load_seam_test.dart dev/fitness/test/config_key_consumers_test.dart && ! rg -q "^database\.fts_language" dev/fitness/test/allowlist/config_key_consumers.txt

dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_kernel/test/storage_exceptions_test.dart && rg -qU "storage_exceptions\.dart'\s*show[^;]*\bStorageConfigurationException\b" packages/dartclaw_kernel/lib/dartclaw_kernel.dart && rg -q "pg_ts_config" packages/dartclaw_core/lib/src/search/postgres_fts_index.dart && ! rg -q "to_regconfig" packages/dartclaw_core/lib/src/search/ && dart analyze --fatal-infos packages/dartclaw_core/test/search/postgres_fts_index_live_test.dart

! rg -q "FullTextIndex|SearchDocument|MemoryIndexProjection|memory_chunks|ts_rank" packages/dartclaw_core/lib/src/knowledge && rg -q "instr\(lower\(" packages/dartclaw_core/lib/src/knowledge/knowledge_fact_search.dart && ! rg -P "\\$\{?\w*[lL]anguage" packages/dartclaw_core/lib/src/knowledge/knowledge_fact_search.dart && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_core/test/knowledge/temporal_knowledge_graph_service_test.dart packages/dartclaw_runtime/test/knowledge/knowledge_hub_service_test.dart && dart analyze --fatal-infos packages/dartclaw_core/test/knowledge/postgres_fact_search_live_test.dart

! rg -q "in-process|openSearchDbInMemory" packages/dartclaw_runtime/lib/src/runtime/storage_wiring.dart && rg -q "^  Future<void> _wirePostgresIndex" packages/dartclaw_runtime/lib/src/runtime/storage_wiring.dart && rg -Fq "if (config.database.backend != DatabaseBackendKind.sqlite) return;" packages/dartclaw_runtime/lib/src/runtime/storage_wiring.dart && ! sed -n '/^  Future<void> _wirePostgresIndex(/,/^  Future<void> _wirePersonalMemoryAfterTaskStorage()/p' packages/dartclaw_runtime/lib/src/runtime/storage_wiring.dart | rg -q "SqliteFtsIndex|SqliteBackend" && rg -q "validatePostgresFtsLanguage" packages/dartclaw_runtime/lib/src/runtime/storage_wiring.dart && rg -q "PostgresFactSearch\(" packages/dartclaw_runtime/lib/src/runtime/storage_wiring.dart && dart test --reporter=failures-only packages/dartclaw_runtime/test/runtime/storage_wiring_backend_selection_test.dart packages/dartclaw_runtime/test/runtime/storage_wiring_memory_preflight_test.dart && dart analyze --fatal-infos packages/dartclaw_runtime/test/runtime/storage_wiring_postgres_search_live_test.dart

! rg -qi "not supported|FTS5" apps/dartclaw_cli/lib/src/commands/rebuild_index_command.dart && rg -q "validatePostgresFtsLanguage" apps/dartclaw_cli/lib/src/commands/rebuild_index_command.dart && dart test --reporter=failures-only apps/dartclaw_cli/test/commands/rebuild_index_command_test.dart && dart analyze --fatal-infos apps/dartclaw_cli/test/commands/rebuild_index_command_postgres_live_test.dart

rg -q "content_tsv" dev/architecture/data-model.md && rg -qi "query.time" dev/architecture/data-model.md && rg -qi "ablaut|irregular" dev/architecture/data-model.md && rg -qi "diacritic" dev/architecture/data-model.md && awk '/^### .rebuild-index.$/,/^## /' docs/guide/cli-reference.md | rg -qi "transaction" && ! rg -q "S09|story S" dev/architecture/data-model.md

test "$(rg -l "@Tags\(\['integration'\]\)" packages/dartclaw_core/test/search/postgres_fts_index_live_test.dart packages/dartclaw_core/test/knowledge/postgres_fact_search_live_test.dart packages/dartclaw_core/test/storage/index_reconciler_postgres_live_test.dart packages/dartclaw_runtime/test/runtime/storage_wiring_postgres_search_live_test.dart apps/dartclaw_cli/test/commands/rebuild_index_command_postgres_live_test.dart | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 5 && (unset DARTCLAW_TEST_POSTGRES_URL; dart analyze --fatal-infos) && dart run dev/tools/arch_check.dart && git diff --check
